expression: z_contact = z_collar - depth in a positive-up coordinate system
preconditions: Explicit route station and projection distance
An independently authorized collar accuracy envelope for absolute elevation use
decisionLogic: Create one relative-depth contact at every internal interval bottom.
Keep every contact point-local unless a separate support-distance rule is supplied.
Translate to absolute elevation only from an authorized accuracy envelope; a publication rounding interval is insufficient.
uncertainty: Collar and depth uncertainties must remain separate and explicit
exclusions: No conversion of reporting precision into accuracy
validationMethod: Positive, boundary, missing accuracy, gap and non-observed interval tests
reopenCondition: Depth uncertainty, inclined borehole geometry, or evidence-backed lateral support is introduced
